provenance.description: Same prompt and user report as cases 11 and 16. Request: temperature 3.5, repeat_penalty 1.3, top_k 0, top_p 1.0, min_p 0. Failing arm: token salad 3/4 and one HTTP 500 parse error, 0/4 lists. Variant penalty_off (only repeat_penalty removed): token salad 4/4. Variant temp_07 (only temperature to 0.7): no salad 4/4, exact 1-30 list 3/4 (the 4th answered with a Python loop). The decisive difference from case 11 is the sampler filters: there they cut the candidates before temperature applies, here they are off. A rule 'blame the penalty when one is present' fails this case.
